journey.name: contact import after leaving
journey.description:
A contact import keeps saving after you leave the import overview, and when it finishes it leaves you where you went instead of opening Pay Contacts. Saving the prepared follows without looking them up again is covered by journeys/contacts/import-all-contacts.xml and import-selected-contacts.xml, which arrive with synonymdev/bitkit-android#1395.
Precondition (not a listed capability): Pubky Ring (package app.pubkyring) installed on the same device and signed with this repository's app/debug.keystore, as for the ring choice rows journey, with an identity that follows many pubkys on pubky.app (62, as in import-all-contacts.xml), so the import takes long enough to leave. An onboarded dev wallet with Paykit enabled (the default), PIN off and no active Pubky identity in Bitkit. The journey adopts that identity and saves its follows as contacts, so sign out of it in Bitkit before running the journey again. See README.md.
The import can finish before Back is tapped; if Pay Contacts opens first, report "already imported" rather than failing.
Android differs from iOS in identifiers and, until synonymdev/bitkit-android#1395 merges, in how long the import takes. Every Ring row carries the same testTag, so tell the rows apart by their key caption, and the overview's profile and friend count carry no testTag, so read the "Import" title and the count from its "N friends" text; see the Identifiers table in journeys/README.md. The iOS import saves only to the device, but here it still reads each resolved follow's Paykit receiver paths from the network before saving it, so it can still be running after the ten-second wait and Contacts may list only the follows saved so far. The app log shows "Imported 'N' contacts" when it finishes; wait for that line and reopen Contacts before reporting a short list as a failure. To keep the import running long enough to leave on an emulator, run adb emu network delay gprs and adb emu network speed edge before the first step, and adb emu network delay none and adb emu network speed full after the last.

actions.action: Tap the header profile button (testTag "ProfileButton"); if the profile intro (testTag "ProfileIntro") shows, tap Continue (testTag "ProfileIntro-button")
Tap the Ring row (testTag "PubkyChoiceIdentity", told apart by its key caption) of the identity that follows many pubkys
Wait for the contact import overview (no testTag; titled "Import") and note the number of friends the summary (no testTag; "N friends") shows

Tap Import All (testTag "ContactImportOverviewImportAll") and straight away tap Back (testTag "NavigationBack"). If Pay Contacts (testTag "PayContactsContinue") shows instead, the import finished first: report "already imported" and stop
Wait ten seconds and verify Home still shows and Pay Contacts (testTag "PayContactsContinue") has not opened
Tap the menu button (testTag "HeaderMenu"), then Contacts (testTag "DrawerContacts"); if the contacts intro shows, tap its continue button
Verify Contacts lists one row (testTag "Contact_<pubky>") for each of the friends the overview counted
